result_text:
The parent landscape report no longer aborts when a sub-landscape has no readable `config.json`. I made the fix in `reports/src/main/java/nl/obren/sokrates/reports/landscape/statichtml/LandscapeReportGenerator.java`, lines 653–656 in `addSubLandscapeSection`.

**The bug:** `getSubLandscapeConfig` returns `null` when the file is missing or unreadable, and the caller then called `.getMetadata()` on it. That was the NullPointerException.

**The change:** the metadata is now read only when the config exists, and the logo condition also checks for null. A row whose config is missing gets the default landscape logo and its link to the index page. Rows with a config keep their own logo.

I did not add a test. The module has no landscape tests, so I checked the change by reading the code. The module compiles, and the existing `ReportFileExporterTest` passes. I did not run a full landscape generation against a broken sub-landscape, so the end-to-end behaviour is unverified. Nothing is committed.
